snippet.title: Monster Alchemy - DEMO Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the latest gameplay trailer for "Monster Alchemy," showcasing its unique blend of RPG mechanics and creature transmutation. This video offers a first look at the diverse in-game mechanics and monster designs. Don't miss the chance to experience the new gameplay by trying out the demo game very soon!

Wishlist on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4013510/Monster_Alchemy/
